note: This file refines error taxonomy without changing model outputs, derived predictions, or the single live-run artifacts.

errors.detail: The model received the Master Plan 2014/2019 boundary qualification but treated the arithmetic difference as the true underlying population change.
The causal conclusion was correctly unsupported, but the descriptive comparison was incorrectly promoted from premise/context to a separately requested claim, producing PARTIALLY_ANSWERABLE.
The model treated an in-domain unavailable year/granularity combination as an absent corpus domain and derived OUT_OF_SCOPE instead of INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
The model used UNAVAILABLE for a missing year without a supplied NOT_AVAILABLE observation, so it could not provide the required ESTABLISHES_UNAVAILABILITY relation.
The model treated an in-domain missing year at subzone granularity as OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than insufficient evidence.
The model attached SUPPORTS to an unsupported requested claim instead of using the observations to contradict the directional premise.
The model attached SUPPORTS to an unsupported requested claim and failed to use CONTRADICTS for the contradicted premise.
